rows.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER royal_champion_insert_r118 BEFORE INSERT ON player_items
 WHEN NEW.equipped=1 AND NEW.rarity='royal' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM players WHERE id=NEW.player_id AND champion_level_r102>=1)
 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'royal_champion_required_r118'); END
rows.review: Read-only champion eligibility predicate with RAISE(ABORT) on unauthorized equipped Royal gear insert/update. No monster, reward or RNG mutation.

 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'royal_champion_required_r118'); END

rows.name: royal_champion_loss_r118
rows.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER royal_champion_loss_r118 AFTER UPDATE OF champion_level_r102 ON players
 WHEN OLD.champion_level_r102>=1 AND NEW.champion_level_r102<1
 BEGIN UPDATE player_items SET equipped=0 WHERE player_id=NEW.id AND equipped=1 AND rarity='royal'; END
